desc:
Ragdoll Hero 🦸💥------ BIG UPDATE AT 100 LIKES!

Become a superhero and send ragdolls flying!

⚡ Use real hero powers: heat vision, repulsor blasts, web shots, rockets and more. Unlock new heroes as you rack up kills.

🚓 Get wanted: cause chaos and the cops come after you. They start with cars, then send SWAT vans and helicopters. Can you survive 5 stars? Blow them up or hide until they lose you.

🌆 Pick a battlefield: the yard with the spider pit and quicksand, the city at night, or the park.

🌪️ Start events: Meteor Rain, Tornado, Black Hole and NUKE.

🎮 Play your way:

Slow-mo to watch every hit up close
Control mode to grab NPCs and drag them on a rope
Sandbox to spawn monsters, villains and giants

👥 Make your own server and fight your friends with full ragdoll physics.

🎁 Free rewards every day, and leaderboards for kills, playtime and VIP.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for new heroes and maps!
